description: Rwofost implements the WOFOST crop model in R using weather, crop, soil and management inputs. The cited provider is Rwofost authors. The model domain and scenario period depend on the user-defined system and inputs; geographic validation and numerical resolution are not established here. The package registry provides public package metadata and documentation links. Licence: GPL-3.0-or-later, read from the CRAN package metadata on 2026-09-27; obtaining it is free of charge. For infrastructure simulation, it can inform irrigation-demand or agricultural water-management scenarios.
